I have implemented `consistentHash` IR construction, validation, route application, policy merging, and unit tests, and set up the gateway translator test case. Waiting for `make analyze` (`task-411`) to finish.
Running the gateway translator test for `consistentHash` (`task-431`).
Re-running the translator test (`task-437`) after quoting `ttl: "3600"` as a duration string.
Running `make analyze` (`task-443`) on `./api/v1alpha1/...`, `./pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/...`, and `./pkg/kgateway/translator/gateway/...`.
Verifying the gateway translator test passes without `REFRESH_GOLDEN` (`task-447`).
Added `spec.consistentHash` support to `TrafficPolicy` on branch `feat/consistent-hash`:

### Summary of Changes

1. **API Types & CRD Generation**
   - Added [`ConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L140-L315) and its sub-types ([`ConsistentHashHeader`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L186-L205), [`RegexRewrite`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L207-L220), [`ConsistentHashCookie`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L222-L253), [`ConsistentHashCookieAttribute`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L255-L268), [`ConsistentHashQueryParameter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L270-L284), [`ConsistentHashFilterState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L286-L300), and [`ConsistentHashSourceIP`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L302-L311)) to [`TrafficPolicySpec`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L132-L135).
   - Regenerated deepcopy functions in [zz_generated.deepcopy.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/zz_generated.deepcopy.go) and the TrafficPolicy CRD manifest in [gateway.kgateway.dev_trafficpolicies.yaml](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/install/helm/kgateway-crds/templates/gateway.kgateway.dev_trafficpolicies.yaml).

2. **Translation, Validation, and Policy Merging**
   - Implemented [`consistentHashIR`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L22-L25), [`constructConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L101-L249), [`applyConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L251-L268), [`mergeHashPolicies`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L287-L368), and [`mergeConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L370-L423) in [consistent_hash.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go):
     - Builds Envoy `RouteAction_HashPolicy` entries in canonical type order (`headers`, `cookies`, `queryParameters`, `filterState`, `sourceIp`) and defaults to a single `sourceIp` hash policy with `terminal=false` when no sub-fields are specified.
     - Enforces `disable: true` exclusivity and suppresses inherited hash policies from broader-scoped policies.
     - Deduplicates entries by identifying key (case-insensitively for `headers`, preserving the first occurrence's casing).
     - Supports header `regexRewrite`, cookie `ttl` (Go duration or integer seconds) and `attributes`, union-merging across policies with canonical re-sorting, higher-priority `sourceIp` retention even when unset, and recording `consistentHash` in `merge.TrafficPolicy.gateway.kgateway.dev` metadata.
   - Wired `consistentHash` into [traffic_policy_plugin.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/traffic_policy_plugin.go), [constructor.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/constructor.go), and [merge.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/merge.go).

3. **Tests**
   - Added unit tests in [consistent_hash_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash_test.go) and translator golden tests in [gateway_translator_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/pkg/kgateway/translator/gateway/gateway_translator_test.go#L790-L799), [consistent-hash.yaml (input)](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/pkg/kgateway/translator/gateway/testutils/inputs/traffic-policy/consistent-hash.yaml), and [consistent-hash.yaml (output)](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xs1zy2hw/pkg/kgateway/translator/gateway/testutils/outputs/traffic-policy/consistent-hash.yaml).
